verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal, so offering git commands such as stash/unstash is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git or any stash capability. The listed commands cover languages, pkg-installed tools, file operations and config, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can stash and unstash changes to temporarily clear my working directory
